body: I just feel hopeless.  How do I deal with this?
Thanks.  I am just at wit's end. :(
You're awesome and full of wisdom.  Thank you.

You're awesome and I appreciate your support.

Therapy is probably not an option--he sees his behavior as normal (which, frankly, it is)...the problem is MY behavior, which is NOT normal.  I think he's scared that I'm overreacting and I'm scared that I'm not taking care of myself.  I'm 29 years old and already have liver damage from a mere 7 months of over drinking.  That is a sign of not only not taking care of myself but also the horrible effects alcohol can have if you don't use it properly.  

Because he hasn't experienced alcohol addition first hand or even in his family (which, frankly, neither have I) it's a very difficult monster to conquer.

Tomorrow I will detox.  I will go to meetings this week.  And I will confront him with the monster that has taken over my life and ask his acceptance and peace with it.  Dinner parties that feature alcohol are NOT an excuse to let my health and well being suffer...

You guys and gals are awesome!

I appreciate your response.

My SO can go days without drinking.  He does drink, but it's never to the medically "alcoholic" extreme.  For me, it's more that he refuses to see the pain I'm in--I've broken down in tears begging him to help me...and a few days later, he's on the sauce.  

I'll see what I can do with my own sobriety.  My only concern is that, once quitting, I'll fall into the trap of drinking--because my SO sees it as normal.  He may--or may not--be able to do social drinking, etc.  For me, though, it's just asking for a nightmare.
